lesson: The system consistently entered long positions into exhaustion zones where RSI divergence and local resistance failures signaled distribution, effectively catching falling knives. The reliance on bullish higher-timeframe structures ignored the immediate SMC-based order flow shifts that preceded each stop-out.
adjustment: Implement a mandatory 'Trend Alignment Filter' that prohibits long entries if the 1h RSI is above 70 or if price is failing to reclaim the previous session's high, regardless of the 4h trend.
methodology_flag: Trust RSI-based exhaustion signals more than 4h structural trend bias on POLUSDT.
